text:
🙏❤️ First of all, I would like to thank this amazing group for all the support you provide. It truly helps so many people stay with the ones they love.
I recently returned from Israel. During my stay, I visited my sister and reconnected with someone who is now my partner. ❤️✨ During that time, we decided to make our relationship official and start building our future together.
Now that I’m back in Peru, we want to begin the partner visa process, but we’re feeling a bit lost and would really appreciate your guidance.

❓I have a few questions:

📄 Where do we submit or upload the documents? Is that the first step?

⚖️ Is it better to hire a lawyer, or can the process be done on our own?

⏳ Since I just returned from Israel, is it better to start the process now or wait a few months before applying?

📝 What is the step-by-step procedure for obtaining the partner visa?

💙 Any advice or personal experience would mean a lot to us. Thank you so much in advance for your help! 🙏🌍
